reviews.text: Chris Calvery, the owner at Calvery Pools, put in a new pool at my neighbor's house.  His subcontractor damaged my fence and property with their truck and Chris has not taken responsibility for this damage and now will not return my phone calls. While initially he acted like he would take care of it, he has dropped the ball claiming none of his subs said they did it. It's possible the driver of a big truck like what did this damage without even knowing it happened since my chain link fence is light compared to the likely concrete truck that caused the damage.  But Chris has not acted professionally by not handling this damage.
reviews.author: Laurie Nesbitt

reviews.text: The Calvery team did a fantastic job with our  backyard project. They were very easy to work with, timely, and did great work. Would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Carson Coker

reviews.text: Calvery Pools offered great, efficient, and friendly service. They were quick with solutions and to help for any needs at a great rate. Would definitely recommend, and will be using them again.
reviews.author: Tristan Paschall

reviews.text: We absolutely loved working with Chris and his teams. Did not believe when he said he could build it in 60 days but he came through! Our pool turned out amazing! We would highly recommend using Calvary Pools.
reviews.author: John Conder

reviews.text: Thanks to Kendall with Calvert Pools! My backyard was a blank slate and he turned it into a true oasis. From design to being able to swim in the pool it was all perfect. Calvery Pools are the go to pool contractors in Lake Highlands. They even installed a putting green for me!
reviews.author: Logan Owensby

reviews.text: Awesome service! I was really pleased how the pool came out and the attention to detail. Highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: Tripp Butts

data.summary: The review set shows a significant red flag: a cluster of recent, brief 5-star reviews contrasts sharply with one detailed, credible 1-star complaint about property damage and ghosting. The low total review volume and the timing pattern of the positive reviews raise authenticity concerns, though the negative review feels very genuine.
fake_signals: Cluster of 5-star reviews posted within a one-month period
Generic, brief positive reviews (e.g., 'Great work from this company')
Low total review count (7) for a pool contractor
authentic_signals: One highly detailed, specific 1-star complaint with names and a clear narrative
Positive reviews mention specific team members (Chris, Kendall) and project types (pool, putting green)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one platform (Google) has a significant rating. No other platforms have sufficient data for comparison.
